messages:
Sam H.: Incoming pen-test vendor confirmed for 2026-07-07 10:00-14:00 UTC. Need a minimal onboarding doc: ephemeral RBAC, KMS delegate pattern, readroom URLs, and retest scheduling. Can someone own coordination?

Lina V.: I'll lead coordination. Plan: create role pt_vendor_temp with AssumeRole from vendor account, no console, session 90m max. Will add a one-click revoke script.

Omar K.: For KMS, avoid granting Decrypt. We'll provide presigned PUTs that enforce SSE-KMS with alias/pt-evidence. If vendor requires encrypt-only, grant Encrypt and GenerateDataKey only. If Decrypt is needed for a narrow test, require approval and rotate key afterwards.

Pri: Observability: spin up a dedicated CloudTrail trail filtered for S3 and KMS events and export hourly to forensics bucket. Capture host audit logs and app request_id headers. Set retention 180 days for this trail copy.

Sam H.: Retest windows: suggest two 90-minute slots in the week after fixes: Mon 14:00-15:30 UTC and Thu 09:00-10:30 UTC. Lina + Omar can staff?

Lina V.: I can take Mon slot. Will also maintain the remediation tracker entries and add columns: engagement_id, vendor_arn, role_name, grant_ids, evidence_bucket, trail_export.

Omar K.: I'll take Thu slot and own the KMS grant issuance/retirement. Sample grant command for encrypt-only uploads (replace GRANTEE):

aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence --grantee-principal GRANTEE --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey --name "pt-upload-<eng-id>"

Omar K.: We'll call retire-grant after the session and record grant id in tracker.

Pri: Alerts: create CloudWatch metric filter for KMS Decrypt and raise a PagerDuty incident if Decrypt > baseline*3 within 10m. Also alert on S3 DeleteObject attempts.

ops-bot: Preflight reminder created: "PT onboarding preflight" scheduled 2026-07-06 15:00 UTC. Invite sent to Lina, Omar, Sam.

Sam H.: Post-engagement checklist: retire grants, revoke temp roles, export and checksum trail snapshot, rotate key if Decrypt occurred, and attach evidence manifest to ticket. Lina will update tracker and close loop with compliance.

Lina V.: I'll post the runbook to the tracker and add the calendar invites. Estimating work: IAM/KMS scripts ~2-3 hrs, Trail snapshot script ~1 hr. We'll reconvene at preflight. Thanks.
